select deadline.* from( SELECT rownum num, A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE < to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline where num = #{days,jdbcType=INTEGER}
